notes.title: Boss Crushers 1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/2b2117d4e8dbbfeb0d6a60d47a8e1170208dba11.png[/img]

This is one of the biggest, if not the most, update we released. Added a bunch of content. Items, abilities, perks. Reworked balance, added rare mechanics, new chests, choice of difficulty.

[h1]Added new level “Bastion”[/h1]
It is possible to get into it only after passing through the three main portals. At the end of the level, you will find the final boss.

[h1]Added new abilities, perks, items.[/h1]

[h1]Game balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Choice of difficulty. You are given three types of difficulty. Depending on your choice, the characteristics of the enemies, the chance of drop of the healing runes.
[*] The balance of enemies - The characteristics of opponents are reworked.
[*] 4 new chests. The higher the rarity of the chest, the better the prey from it
[*] Balance of abilities. Abilities characteristics are reworked
[*] Rare items, spells and perks. Some elements of the game now appear less often
[*] The balance of traders. A set of traders products is reworked
[*] The random item merchant has been reworked. The cost for each attempt to get the item grows gradually
[*] Maximum guild level - 59
[/list]

[h1]Rest[/h1]
[list]
[*] New chat
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Minor UI changes
[*] Added German, French, Chinese
[*] Many bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 16. Heroes.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/7a9ea251cd434994b67cb5e92d8accfbd99c0954.png[/img]

We dedicated this update to characters. We added two new characters: Druid and Bounder. In addition, each character now has its own unique features. For example, Crystal Keeper drops energy spheres. If the character picks up one of these spheres, the character receives a shield and is able to attack opponents with chain lightning. And the Witch has an ability to revive enemies that she has killed in the form of shadows.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/83ce2d90cb0d72c71c5c2bdfa8f4fab6dde3bc50.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- New character: Druid. The hermit, who has been blessed by the spirit of nature, acquires his power and knowledge from the latter. The taciturn and gloomy druid does not get along well with other people and does not like to make acquaintances. Druids are never seen without their pets.  The maximum pet health and dealt damage depends on the maximum health of the Druid. It is also possible to find new pets in dungeons.

- New character: Bounder. She is a typical representative of the tribe of carefree little people. Their worldview consists of setting traps, playing tricks, telling jokes, and having fun. Their natural predisposition to use magic makes them a headache for everyone around them. The Bounder can detect hidden caches in the dungeons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/42aebaaa76dd39f2feedd2fa03d2c3061cb396cc.jpg[/img]

- System of unique features for each character. 

- Talents to unlock heroes. Crystal Keeper can be opened at level 5, Druid and Bounder at 15 and 25, respectively.

- 5 new talents. All 5 talents are accessible starting at Level 25.

- Many bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Alpha 15. Portals.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/144931bdd435e8f4f08f6d98f6ebada104574016.png[/img]

[h1]Portals.[/h1]
In this update, we have added a new feature - portals. To open a portal, you must first save a character - the master of the portals, and also bring him an object - the portal stone. Each portal stone leads to its own level with new enemies and with increased complexity. At the end of the level you will find a large chest with a worthy reward.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/2a9d53cc65f5c952d037e7abda564185d6e295a0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes.[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new character of the Citadel is the master of portals. He opens portals that lead to new levels.
[*] New levels with their environment and a set of enemies.
[*] New enemies on levels.
[*] A system of dialogues with the characters of the Citadel.
[*] New achievements.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/d5cfa7e3231bd8ba28efb5c882ffd29c754f5136.jpg[/img]

[h1]The rest.[/h1]
[list]
[*] We modified the Dark character in the citadel - now he sells goods.
[*] Each hero gets a personalized additional ability at the start.
[*] Many bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 14. The Citadel.
notes.content:
[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/60a7e0391d31c7ed1c903816d245f3432516a84b.png [/img]

 [h1] The Citadel. [/h1]
The Citadel is the home of our characters. Each new character gets into the citadel and only then you go to the dungeons. Every time you complete a dungeon, you return to the citadel.
[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/27309698b5f5bb47acb23f2252f531eee5350a3e.png [/img]
- New groups. You can now invite friends and form groups right from the citadel.
- Obelisk and portals. In the center of the citadel is the obelisk. After its activation, 3 portals appear. Now you can choose in which order you will pass the locations. The difficulty is being calibrated.
- Guild Master. New character. Located in the citadel.
- Training dolls. Want to know your damage rates? then you here.

[h1] Interface. [/h1]
We completely reworked the interface. All windows, animations, fonts, etc. have changed.
[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/f6036a12afef039fb4391b0b7ad080a3f23b979a.png [/img]

[h1] Other. [/h1]
- voice acting. almost all the characters received voice acting.
- artistic description of abilities, items, enemies, etc. in the atlas.
- Guards and prisoners. Now at the levels, you can meet the prisoners in the cells, after the release they will help you in every way in further adventures. But be careful, the guards are quite dangerous opponents.
- Tokens. Now the schemes are sold for tokens, not for talent points. Tokens can be found in boss chests.
- New main menu.
- Fade objects. Now, some objects in the game world are hidden if they block the view of the character.
- Indicators of enemies behind the screen
- Now online player status is always displayed correctly
